title: Buttery Cardamom Layered Paratha
description: A layered flatbread infused with the warmth of cardamom and the richness of butter, perfect for a delicious breakfast or snack.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, salt, and ground cardamom.
Gradually add the melted ghee or butter and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4 equal parts and roll each part into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 6-7 inches in diameter.
Brush the surface with melted ghee or butter and sprinkle with water.
Fold the dough into a triangle or a square shape, depending on your preference.
Roll out the dough into a thin layer, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Cook the paratha for 1-2 minutes on each side, until it's golden brown and puffed up.
Serve hot with your favorite chutney or raita.
